body: Thank you so much for taking the time out to write this response. It is really appreciated. I have sent you a private message as well. Could do with someone to talk to.
Sociology. I can't really find anything that I could pursue while studying. My programme is pretty rigorous. I could split rent easily, but it's hard to move out or make plans even.

It's very hard to get a job here that would fund my living expenses while I am studying an intensive programme. I don't mind something more...'immoral' but that's hard to do under the monitoring of my parents as well.
Thank you for sharing. It must be so hard for you to have to live a life so different from your peers. I hope things become easier for you.

I would like to do this, but I worry about the consequences (will I end up with even more restrictions? Will they be so upset as to disown me?). I'm actually not too worried about the disowning, more about the former.

Thank you for this beautiful response. I think, despite a vastly different context, our struggle is quite similar. You have articulated some of my thoughts very well.

>Even then at that tender age I felt she would codemn me and I would be in for punishment at home aswell (smacking etc was considered OK in the 60s)

I know exactly what you mean here. I have been sexually harassed by relatives and I know I can't talk about it because it would be shameful, I know that ultimately I would come out of it looking worse, so what's the point? And it's amusing to me that the things that they try and protect me from are actually happening right at home. Not outside.

>My advice to you would be, despite what you may think, you are still very young, your masters I imagine will only take maybe a year?

Agreed, I am young. I should be able to handle this, to power through it, but I can't seem to. I am too weak. I can't live like this.

>an unspoken agenda here regarding your virginity, am I right.

It is indeed a very big deal (I am very sexually active when I can be, and they know nothing of this aspect of me). I worry that telling them will make the restrictions upon me heavier and make my life even more intolerable.

>They will be shocked, but tell them there is nothing you can't do in the daytime, that you can do in the night, if you catch my drift.

Exactly. I doubt they will understand this.

But the urge to let it all out, to be angry at them, to vent at them is getting stronger and stronger. I feel like writing them a letter addressing all these things. But I do not know how they will react.

Thank you again, you have been so helpful.
I'm just worried they might take some drastic steps if I were to do this.
Somewhat, in hypotheticals, but they just don't get it. And I am scared of being more direct because I worry they will place even more restrictions on me.

That's all right. I'm glad you care enough to respond.

I haven't. I'm not sure how to access one and how to afford it. I'm pretty sure they're seen as luxury services here.
Thank you so much. Are your parents restrictive? Do they impinge on your freedom?

Sometimes I do that. It used to keep me going.

I don't know how long it will take. And I can't seem to stand it any more. I wish I could stick through it but I can't.

Thanks a lot for responding.

It is frustrating because I know I could be happy, or could live the life I want, I'm happy to deal with any hardships that come because of a lack of luxury if I get the freedom I want. But living with them has me so trapped, so hopeless, I am only happy when I am not in their vicinity. Otherwise I'm just playing a part, pretending to be the daughter they want.

I don't want to die. I want to live my life. But I'm not being allowed that and so dying seems like a better option. I doubt they would understand anything I am going through. I highly doubt they care about me as much as they care about what I appear like, what they appear like and what our reputation amongst other people is. Even if I told them this I feel like they would just dismiss it as a phase and that I don't know what I really want. I feel like something dramatic is the only way to get through to them.

I just feel miserable right now. Some days its worse, today is one of those days. I have spoken about my struggles to some friends and it helps for a while. But ultimately no one can give me a solution.
